text: Decided to explore the mines.  There must be some way to bypass the maze. If only there were a way across the pit of lava.  But my maps indicate there must be a secret door in this area.  I enter now...

name: a scroll
text: I'm trapped now.  I dare not return from whence I came, and I dare not brave the caverns.  So many hateful dead things.  If only I'd known this key opened the door on the far side of the lava pit, I wouldn't be in this fix.  I think I'll just rest and wait now.  Perhaps my companions may find me...
